findings.message: Condition on flow "Flow_vip" is complex (length=42, nesting=0, operators=1, variables=6).
findings.suggestion: Consider extracting complex FEEL expressions into named variables or decision tables.

findings.message: Element "Task_charge" (serviceTask) has 2 incoming flows. Non-gateway elements must have at most one incoming flow.
findings.suggestion: Add an exclusive gateway before this element to join the incoming flows.

findings.message: Call activity "Create invoice" has no error boundary event.
findings.suggestion: Add an error boundary event to handle errors propagated from the called process.

findings.message: Start event "Order received" has no documentation describing expected input variables.
findings.suggestion: Add documentation listing the process input variables so callers know the expected contract.
Set a job type — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy a task with no task definition.

findings.message: Message catch "Await payment confirmation" (receiveTask) has no zeebe:subscription correlationKey.
findings.suggestion: Set a correlation key — required for every message catch in Camunda 8.

findings.message: "Determine shipping cost" (businessRuleTask) has neither a zeebe:taskDefinition type nor a zeebe:calledDecision.
findings.suggestion: Set a decisionId or a job type.

findings.message: Call activity "Create invoice" has no zeebe:calledElement processId.
findings.suggestion: Set the process id to call.
Set a job type — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy a task with no task definition.
